digest.component_or_area: plan review gate — candidate evaluation and metrics
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, recall-stripped clone driver, pure metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not merged to main because it only serves the rejected batch.

The expensive ~450-run LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep + precise ~50-ticket×3 candidate + ×3 current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder, which accumulates the same verdict-perturbation signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.

The deterministic WIP deliverables include reproducible stratified sample filtering, frozen plan-v3 baseline with material fingerprints, recall-stripped review clone (delete REVIEW_RESULT.json), and LLM-free metrics (build_matrix, criterion_deltas, tkey, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) with golden-test coverage.
Baseline history mining is infeasible because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed; the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical baseline corpus.

The two-tier design isolates candidate effect by replaying both candidate and current gate fresh (N=3, two-level median) with current-vs-current null floor to control for LLM nondeterminism and detect R1 false-positive violations (>3/30 new blocking findings or >1 median advisory delta).
